newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: FORECAST - No change to Bank of Portugal rates.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - No change to Bank of Portugal rates.

text.p: The Bank of Portugal was expected to leave both its repurchase pact rate and its drain, or absorption rate unchanged on Tuesday when it announces money market conditions for the next commercial bank reserve period, according to a Reuter poll of analysts.

The analysts were unanimous in predicting an unchanged repo rate of 6.00 percent, with the drain rate remaining steady at 5.70 percent because of the recent international turbulence stirred up by the French elections.
The Bank will announce the terms at 1315 GMT.

The following banks and brokerages took part in the poll and were prepared to be identified: Banco Finantia, Banco Portugues de Investimento, Banco Mello de Investimentos, IMF-Informacao de Mercados Financeiros, Siemca-Sociedade Mediadora de Capitais, Fincor, Credit Lyonnais, Banco de Comercio e Industria.
